_comment: Copy this to speaker_blocklist.json (gitignored). Object keyed by names whisper recurrently hallucinates as a leading speaker label WITHOUT a title (titled labels like 'Name, Ph.D.:' / 'Dr. X:' / 'Speaker N:' strip automatically and need no entry here). The name is stripped when it opens the transcript followed by a separator run — colon, comma, dash, or period — plus whitespace (e.g. 'Claudius, ', 'Claudio Pagliauvao- ', 'Claudius C. '). Values are free-text notes; '_'-prefixed keys are ignored. Matched case-insensitively, only at the very start, never when it would empty the take.
